groups.defect: In EmbeddableHostsController, update and destroy use the result of EmbeddableHost.where(id:).first without checking for nil. An unknown or already-deleted id raises NoMethodError and returns a 500 instead of a not-found error.

answer.reasoning: The two suggestions are duplicates. Both cover lines 9-18 of embeddable_hosts_controller.rb and report the same defect: update and destroy both act on a lookup result that can be nil. Each one already names both actions and gives the same fix, a nil check that returns a not-found error. Either comment alone covers everything the other says, so a merged comment needs nothing extra and needsUnifiedComment is false. Judge 2 set it to true, but no member reports anything the other leaves out.
